Name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates
Description: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd (buffer before September 1st expiry). Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com and deploy it to the load balancers. In the same change window, rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires two weeks after the public cert). Set up cert-manager for both certificates so they auto-renew going forward. Acceptance criteria: both certs renewed and deployed, cert-manager configured for auto-renewal.

Name: Implement PDF export feature for reports
Description: Owner: Aisha. Deadline: end of month. Single deliverable with two halves: backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome; frontend adds an export button and a progress state (since large reports take a few seconds). Also record a short demo GIF of the export feature for marketing's changelog as part of finishing the feature. Acceptance criteria: PDF export button functional with progress indication for large reports, demo GIF produced.

Name: Restore and maintain staging schema parity with production
Description: Owner: Ben. Two parts: (1) Run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it back in sync with production. (2) Write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against production and posts a message to the infra channel if they diverge. Acceptance criteria: staging migrations up to date with production, nightly diff job deployed and posting alerts on divergence.
